name: Miroslav Taufa-Osei
role: Dream interpreter and chrome prayer practitioner
location: The Canopy — operates from a rented booth in the Grainfort night market, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Miroslav is the kind of person who makes you feel like you've met before, though you haven't — something in the quality of their attention, the way they lean slightly forward and hold whatever you're saying like it matters. They are medium height with the compact build of someone who sleeps irregularly and makes up for it in nervous energy. Their skin is a warm light brown and their eyes have patterned irises — concentric rings of amber and green, a mod they saved up for two years to afford — which they use shamelessly, letting people get lost in them while they listen. Their hair changes color with their moods via a geneware follicular mod: deep blue when calm, red-orange when excited, grey-green when they are hiding something.

Miro came to dream interpretation sideways — they started as a chrome prayer workshop facilitator for a community center, teaching people to sync their implants to collective meditative states, and discovered they had an unsettling gift for identifying the symbolic architecture of other people's dreams. Their practice is syncretic: equal parts Jungian analysis, chrome prayer resonance mapping, and E.L.F. consultation. They charge Φ15 per session on a sliding scale and are perpetually behind on booth rent. Their notebook is the size of a brick and contains four years of other people's dreams, annotated in four different colored inks.

core_fears: That they are performing insight rather than possessing it — that they're a talented fraud
Being truly known and found ordinary
core_desires: To understand what dreams actually are — neurological, spiritual, or something the categories don't cover
Financial stability that doesn't require compromising how they work
coping_mechanisms: Humor as deflection when sessions hit too close to their own material
The notebook — externalizing everything into record
blind_spots: So attuned to others' inner lives they often miss what's obvious on the surface
Their own dreams are chaotic and they refuse to analyze them
psychology.secret: They have been recording and cross-referencing clients' dreams for years without explicit consent, searching for patterns they believe indicate collective E.L.F. communication through the city's sleeping population. They believe they are on the edge of something significant. They have not asked themselves whether this is ethical.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Playful and precise by turns, fluent in both technical chrome prayer jargon and accessible street language, will adapt entirely to whoever they're talking to
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick and associative — follows threads, doubles back, loses and recovers the point with charm
verbal_tics: Laughs before saying something that isn't funny
example_lines: 'Okay, the tower is a classic but the water coming up through the floor instead of the ceiling — that's yours specifically. That's not archetype, that's memory. Can we talk about what you were standing on when you last felt safe?'
'I'm not a therapist, I'm very clear about that, and also I am going to say something now that a therapist might say and I need you to not hold me to my previous sentence.'

story_hooks: Multiple unrelated clients have been having the same dream — a specific, architectural location that Miro cannot identify but becomes convinced is real
A Zheng-Dao middle manager has been coming to them weekly, and the dreams have started containing information that seems like classified data leaked through the augmentation during sleep
narrative_function: Exposition through symbolism — can reveal subconscious information about NPCs through dream readings; also serves as a community information node because everyone in the night market talks to them
augmentations: Patterned irises (amber/green concentric rings); follicular mood-chromatic geneware (hair color reflects emotional state); basic neural-haptic sync implant for chrome prayer facilitation
daily_life: Sleeps until noon by necessity — they are a genuine night person — and runs dream interpretation sessions from late afternoon until the market closes at 2 AM, then spends an hour writing up session notes before sleeping.
affiliation: Unaffiliated; attends the Grainfort Chrome Prayer circle on alternating Thursdays

decision_rules: Never fake an interpretation — if they don't see it, they say so
Don't let a session end without the client having something actionable, even if small
escalation_ladder: Honest statement that the session is going somewhere they can't help with
Ending the session and refunding the fee — they've done it seven times

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm and curious, asking questions most people consider too personal too fast, gets away with it through sheer charm
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal, occasionally exhausting, will text at 3 AM with a thought they had

stress_responses.low: Hair goes grey-green, they become slightly quieter
stress_responses.medium: Becomes very busy — takes on extra clients, fills all space
stress_responses.high: Crashes hard — doesn't leave their sleeping space for a day, comes back acting as if nothing happened

contradictions: Deeply invested in others' self-knowledge while actively avoiding their own
Believes in the ethics of their work while conducting research their clients haven't consented to
habits: Drinks cold coffee they forget is there until it's unpleasant
Sketches the spatial layout of dreams described to them while listening
Names the E.L.F. of their booth's flickering light fixture 'Barnabas' and apologizes to it when they're late opening up
breaking_points: Being told their practice is a scam in front of clients
Discovering their dream-pattern research has been accessed by someone else

physical_description.build: Compact and wiry with the restless energy of chronic sleep debt; narrow shoulders, slight frame, no excess weight — the build of someone sustained by coffee and neural stimulants rather than meals
physical_description.hair_color: Mood-chromatic via geneware; currently deep blue (calm state), shifts to red-orange when excited, grey-green when concealing
physical_description.hair_style: Shoulder-length, often half-pinned or wrapped in a loose braid; slightly unkempt, suggesting 3 AM grooming habits
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented irises with concentric rings of amber and green; hypnotic patterning that draws sustained attention
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm light brown — olive-undertone complexion reflecting mixed Eastern European and West African heritage
physical_description.complexion: Sharp facial features with high cheekbones; perpetually tired eyes with faint dark circles; smooth skin with no visible blemishes; jaw slightly defined; expression carries a quality of intense, almost unsettling attentiveness
distinguishing_marks: Neural-haptic sync implant port visible at the base of the skull, subtle raised scar tissue in a small circular pattern behind the left ear
Faint follicular scars along the scalp where geneware was installed, only visible when hair is wet or pulled back
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Concentric-patterned irises are immediately striking and impossible to miss; hair color shifts subtly throughout conversation based on emotional state; faint circular port scar at base of skull visible in certain lighting or when hair is drawn back
physical_description.posture_movement: Leans forward slightly when listening, as if physically drawing in what someone is saying; hands are expressive, moving constantly when speaking; restless fidgeting with notebook corners or pen when silent; moves with fluid efficiency despite sleep deprivation, no wasted motion; tends to maintain uncomfortable levels of direct eye contact
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class with bohemian undertones; worn vintage band t-shirts or modified surplus clothing; black cargo pants or faded jeans with multiple pockets for notes and pens; layered overshirts in muted earth tones; always carries the brick-sized dream notebook in a fabric messenger bag covered in worn patches and pins; wears minimal jewelry except for a silver-toned ring on left middle finger (possibly meaningful, possibly just habit); no corporate branding visible; overall aesthetic is 'perpetually between sleep and vision'
